coordinate_frame: world X/Y/Z; N s for impulses and rad/s for differential angular rates
moments: N m s around a nonrotating point falling with gravity from the initial wrist pivot. The missed parcel is translated back to its incoming line for this balance.
reference: Clear run has the identical native segment schedule, masses, arm state, drives and gravity. Only the parcel lateral offset changes. Force balance differences include the motor and constraint response.
